tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, menus and inputs sitting on `surface`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Code blocks and readouts: anything typed or measured.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed tint behind buttons and rows that have no fill of their own.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and card edges. Not for control borders.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of buttons, inputs and other controls on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken` (3:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy, headings, logo brackets and the bold half of a wordmark, on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken` and `surface-hover`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, captions and the “open” half of a wordmark, on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken` and `surface-hover`.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Pollen yellow, the Open Beekeeping parent colour, as a fill: primary buttons, the parent's logo cell and icon tile. Never text. On the light theme it is too pale to stand alone, so keep it inside `ink` linework or behind `on-brand` text.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for anything filled with `brand`.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text, marks and outlines on a `brand` or `brand-hover` fill.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Brand-coloured text: links, code prompts and kickers on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: sub-apiary
tokens.usage: OpenApiary's product colour, as a fill: its logo cell, icon tile and product badge. Always appears with the product name.

tokens.name: on-sub-apiary
tokens.usage: Text and marks on a `sub-apiary` fill.

tokens.name: sub-bka
tokens.usage: OpenBKA's product colour, as a fill: its logo cell, icon tile and product badge. Always appears with the product name.

tokens.name: on-sub-bka
tokens.usage: Text and marks on a `sub-bka` fill.

tokens.name: sub-spare
tokens.usage: An unassigned product colour, held for the next sub-brand. Rename it when a product claims it.

tokens.name: on-sub-spare
tokens.usage: Text and marks on a `sub-spare` fill.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Status: all well. Text and status marks on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken`; always with a word and its square mark.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Status: needs a look. Text and status marks on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken`; always with a word and its triangle mark.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Status: act now, and form errors. Text, status marks and error borders on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken`; always with a word and its diamond mark.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a solid 2px ring, offset 2px so it sits on the surface around the control, never on the control's own fill.

families.mono: "Martian Mono SemiCondensed", "Martian Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per page: the page title or a hero line.

styles.name: heading
styles.sample: Tools beekeepers can read, fix and share

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card and panel headings; the value in a readout.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Free to use, open to change.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, badges, navigation and form labels; lowercase.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code, commands, readings and anything typed or measured.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a status mark and its word; label to input.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside a control; between buttons; button padding (vertical).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between stacked items in a card; input padding (horizontal).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between related blocks; button padding (horizontal).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; header padding; gaps between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page gutters and gaps between major sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Everything by default: buttons, badges, inputs, cards, icon tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Large floating surfaces only: dialogs and menus.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Avatars and round toggles. Not for buttons or badges.
